prompts.title: Cute 3D Couple Taking a Selfie
prompts.prompt:
Create a high-quality stylized 3D digital illustration of a couple taking a selfie, shown from approximately the upper thighs against a clean, seamless white studio background.
Face Matching: Accurately preserve and match both subjects’ facial identities to their respective reference images, maintaining their exact face shape, proportions, and distinctive facial features. Keep both faces highly recognizable and faithful to the references while naturally adapting them into the premium stylized 3D animated aesthetic.
The woman stands in the foreground on the left, holding a modern light blue/silver smartphone vertically in her raised left hand, taking the selfie. She has long, voluminous wavy hair, expressive eyes, defined eyebrows, soft glowing skin, and a warm, cheerful smile. She wears a fitted light pastel-blue short-sleeve T-shirt tucked into high-waisted black jeans. Her right arm hangs naturally by her side.
The man stands closely behind and slightly to her right, leaning naturally toward her. He has natural, neatly styled hair, expressive eyes, and a warm, friendly smile. He wears a crisp white button-down shirt with the sleeves rolled up, paired with black trousers. His left arm wraps naturally around the woman's waist, while his right hand rests casually inside his trouser pocket.
Both subjects pose closely and naturally as a happy couple, looking toward the smartphone camera with warm, affectionate, joyful expressions. Their body proportions and anatomy are natural and balanced.
Use a polished cinematic 3D character-rendering style, with smooth realistic skin, detailed individual hair strands, realistic fabric textures, subtle facial details, soft shadows, gentle highlights, and refined glossy rendering. Use soft diffused studio lighting from the front and slightly above, creating an evenly illuminated, bright, clean appearance with subtle contact shadows.
Composition: vertical portrait, centered framing, upper-thigh composition, both subjects clearly visible, smartphone clearly visible, balanced spacing, clean white background, premium commercial-quality 3D render, highly detailed, sharp focus, 8K, 4:5 aspect ratio.

Turn them into an adorable husband and wife standing close together on a small round display base. Preserve their recognizable age, facial features, hairstyle, glasses if present, skin tone, and warm loving expressions, but render them in a soft Pixar-style / clay-toy figurine look.

The man stands on the left with a gentle smile, one arm lovingly around the woman’s shoulder, while the woman stands on the right, smiling warmly up at him. Their pose should feel affectionate, calm, and lifelong-romantic.
Dress both subjects in outfits inspired by their own cultural background, keeping the clothing elegant, traditional or semi-traditional, age-appropriate, modest, and visually harmonious. prompts.title: Friendly 3D Male Avatar
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image only as the identity reference. Preserve the subject’s recognizable facial structure, natural age group, hairstyle, hair color, and overall likeness. Keep children looking like children, adults like adults, and elderly subjects elderly. Preserve facial hair only when it exists in the reference with same density.

Style
Create a premium cute 3D animated movie-character avatar in a vertical 4:5 aspect ratio. Use a full polished Pixar-style look: softly rounded facial forms, large warm expressive eyes, smooth stylized skin shading, detailed sculpted hair, crisp clean edges, and high-end cinematic 3D rendering.
Make the subject look charming and slightly cute through gentle facial proportions, soft eyes, and a natural smile. Do not make adults look childlike. Do not make it semi-realistic, anime, chibi, plastic, or toy-like.

Pose
Use a close near-front three-quarter pose, not a wide side profile. Turn the shoulders and head only slightly, around 15–20 degrees to one side. The face should remain mostly directed toward the viewer, with both eyes clearly visible and nearly equal in size. One cheek and ear may be slightly more visible than the other.
Keep the upper body relaxed with a small natural shoulder angle. Do not make the torso turn 30–45 degrees away from the camera. Do not create a stiff straight-on passport pose.

Expression
Give the subject a soft, friendly, confident, slightly cute expression with a small closed-mouth smile. Keep the eyes warm and naturally focused toward the camera. No exaggerated smile, raised eyebrows, sharp eyes, or overly mature serious expression.

Framing
Strict close avatar framing: show the subject from mid-chest upward only. Crop the lower frame at mid-chest, never at the abdomen or waist.
The head must appear large and dominant in the image. Keep the top of the hair only about 8–10% below the top edge. Let the shoulders extend close to both side edges, with very little side space. The subject should fill most of the 4:5 canvas. Do not zoom out, do not show arms below the upper chest, and do not leave large empty background areas.

Glasses
Add neat matte black rectangular eyeglasses with medium-thick black frames, black temples, clear lenses, subtle reflections, and correct three-quarter perspective. Keep the glasses proportional to the face and clearly visible. Do not use gold, beige, transparent, or oversized frames.

Outfit
Dress the subject in a warm light camel-tan zip-front casual jacket with a broad soft collar, clean stitched seams, soft fabric texture, and a subtle chest pocket. Keep the jacket open over a plain off-white crew-neck T-shirt.
Do not make it a button-front overshirt. Do not add multiple oversized flap pockets, military styling, or unnecessary buttons.

Hair
Preserve the hairstyle and hair color from the reference, but render the hair with a full, rounded, premium animated 3D silhouette, clearly defined strands, soft volume, and natural flow. Keep a few soft loose strands near the forehead only when appropriate to the reference.

Background & Lighting
Use a seamless white studio background with a very subtle cream-gray falloff. No text, logo, icon, sparkle, watermark, props, or decorative elements.
Use soft warm studio lighting from the upper-left, gentle front fill on the face, subtle shadows under the chin and jacket collar, and delicate golden highlights along the hair and outer jacket edge.

Final Result
A close, polished, cute animated avatar with a large face, compact chest-up composition, slight near-front three-quarter pose, black rectangular glasses, warm tan zip jacket, and clean white studio background.

prompts.title: The Daydreaming Traveler
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image only for face and identity reference. Preserve the subject’s recognizable facial features and overall likeness with high accuracy.
Create a high-quality 3D animated portrait in a vertical 4:5 aspect ratio. Show the subject as a stylized mini adult version of themselves, with a slightly smaller, shorter, more compact body and a slightly larger head relative to the body. The miniature effect should be clearly visible, but the subject must still look like an adult, not a child, baby, toy, or exaggerated chibi character.
Show the subject sitting cross-legged on the floor in a relaxed, casual pose. One elbow rests on a knee, with that hand gently supporting the cheek. The other hand rests naturally near the ankle or lower leg. Keep the expression soft, pleasant, and thoughtful, with a gentle closed-mouth smile and eyes looking slightly upward to one side, creating a dreamy mood.
Place the subject lower in the frame with generous empty space above the head, so the character feels smaller inside the composition. Keep the full body, full hair, shoes, suitcase, and backpack clearly visible without cropping too close.
Outfit: vibrant orange knitted cardigan, light pastel blue T-shirt, medium blue jeans, navy-gray-and-white lace-up sneakers, and a simple wristwatch. Keep the colours clean and vibrant.
Add two travel props: a compact gray suitcase placed on the floor beside the subject, and a soft gray backpack positioned behind one side of the body with a visible shoulder strap near the shoulder, so it looks like the subject is still loosely wearing or carrying it rather than it being placed separately.
Use a clean pure white studio background with bright, soft, diffused high-key lighting and soft natural floor shadows only. Render the image in a premium polished 3D cartoon style with detailed hair strands, expressive glossy eyes, smooth natural skin shading, realistic knit texture, crisp clothing folds, and clean modern travel-bag details. No text, no border, and no extra objects.

prompts.title: The Perfect Pout
prompts.prompt:

The final character must closely follow the reference style: oversized round head, tiny seated body, big glossy innocent eyes looking slightly upward, sad but adorable pout expression, softly raised worried eyebrows, tiny rounded nose, chubby rosy cheeks, subtle freckles, and a heart-melting cute emotional mood. Keep the expression sad and pouty, but not crying, no tears, no dramatic sadness.
Create a full-body seated pose exactly like the reference: the character sitting cross-legged on the floor, body centered, knees bent outward, small hands gently resting together in front of the feet, shy and innocent posture, head slightly large and tilted naturally. Keep the composition clean and minimal with the full character visible, not cropped, placed in the lower-middle of the frame with plenty of white empty space around her.
Hair should be stylized from the uploaded subject, but rendered in the same soft detailed chibi illustration style with fine individual strands, soft volume, natural shine, and loose wispy hairs around the face. If the reference subject has long hair, convert it into a cute messy high bun or a soft childlike chibi hairstyle while keeping the subject’s identity cues. Outfit should stay simple and close to the reference style: dusty pink oversized t-shirt and mustard-yellow loose cropped pants, soft fabric folds, natural cartoon proportions, no sweater, no leggings, no shoes unless the uploaded subject strongly requires them.
Use a clean pure white background only, with no room, no wall corner, no window, no wooden floor, no furniture, no props, no decorative elements. Add only a very soft contact shadow under the seated body. Rendering style should be premium soft 3D cartoon mixed with polished digital painting, high-quality storybook character illustration, smooth but not plastic, detailed hair strands, soft skin texture, warm gentle lighting, crisp focus, high-resolution finish, adorable emotional charm. No text, no signature, no watermark, no logo. Aspect ratio 4:5.

prompts.title: Digital Twin
prompts.prompt:
Create a 4:5 vertical premium cinematic portrait of me standing beside a cute soft 3D animated version of myself.
The real subject stands on the right and the animated version stands on the left. Both subjects stand close together against a dark warm-gray urban concrete wall with subtle texture. Their body language should feel relaxed, natural, and grounded, as if they are standing very near the wall and lightly resting against it. Both subjects have their arms crossed. Keep only a very subtle outward/back-to-back angle, not a strong side pose. Their shoulders may lightly brush or stay very close, while both faces remain turned toward the camera.
The real subject should be fully photorealistic, with accurate facial likeness, natural skin texture, realistic hair, expressive eyes, and a soft confident smile. He wears a black oversized printed t-shirt with a bold modern urban chest graphic and blue slightly distressed jeans.
The animated version should be the same subject in a cute premium 3D animated form. The rendering must be soft, smooth, warm, and polished, with gentle rounded features, expressive eyes, and a charming Pixar-like softness.

He must be clearly smaller than the real subject in both height and overall visual mass. The real subject must remain the main dominant subject, and the animated version must feel like a small companion version of the same person. Give the animated version a mini compact body, narrow small shoulders, short torso, short arms and legs, and a larger expressive head, but do not make him visually overpowering or too wide. He should feel light, compact, cute, and secondary in the frame. He wears a matching black printed t-shirt and blue distressed jeans.
Lighting is very important: Use soft, balanced, bright-enough cinematic lighting — not dark, not flat, and not over-bright. The faces, t-shirts, and jeans should be clearly visible, with soft frontal / slightly top-front illumination and a smooth warm-neutral tone. Keep the background slightly blurred, moodier and slightly darker than the subjects. Preserve the soft deep wall-shadow effect behind the animated subject and between both subjects, so the image has depth, richness, and a premium cinematic feel. The result should look well-lit but still moody, exactly like the original image.
The background should remain a simple dark muted gray urban wall with subtle concrete texture, soft tonal variation, softly blurred and no strong design, no graffiti, no posters, and no distractions.
The final image should feel like a premium real-person + animated-self portrait, with soft polished animated rendering, correct size hierarchy, bright-enough cinematic lighting, relaxed wall-side pose, and a clearly smaller cute animated companion.
Important locks:


Keep the real subject visually dominant

Keep the animated version clearly smaller and lighter in visual presence

Keep the soft wall-shadow depth

Keep the dark warm-gray urban wall

Keep the animated rendering soft, smooth, and cute

Maintain 4:5 vertical aspect ratio
